summary.goal: Support persistent guardian agents that shadow workers, maintain context across phases (ideation->planning->execution), and intervene when they observe violations. Unlike task agents (spawn->work->exit), guardians persist and accumulate understanding.

acceptance_criteria.description: Guardian agent config in forge-config.yaml: enabled, shadow targets, speak_on triggers
Spawn guardian with Relay shadowOf capability
Guardian receives trajectory from previous phases as context
Guardian can speak on specific trigger events (security_concern, boundary_violation, etc.)
Guardian trajectory persists at project scope (not just run scope)
Predefined guardian types: Security, Architect, QA
Guardian interventions recorded in run trajectory
Guardian retrospective at run completion

observations: Guardian vs Task agent: persistent vs ephemeral, accumulated vs task-scoped context
Relay shadow capability enables non-intrusive observation
speak_on triggers prevent noise - only speak when relevant
patterns: Shadow agent pattern from Relay SDK

steps.title: Define guardian configuration schema
steps.description: Define configuration format for guardian agents

acceptance_criteria.description: GuardianConfigSchema: { type: 'Security' | 'Architect' | 'QA' | 'Compliance', enabled: bool, shadow_targets: string[], speak_on: string[] }
speak_on examples: security_concern, credential_exposure, boundary_violation, api_inconsistency, test_coverage_drop
Loaded from forge-config.yaml guardians section

steps.title: Add guardian trajectory table to storage
steps.description: Schema for guardian-specific trajectory at project scope

acceptance_criteria.description: CREATE_GUARDIAN_TRAJECTORIES_TABLE: event_id PK, project_id, guardian_type, observation, concern_level, recommendation, timestamp
concern_level: 'info' | 'warning' | 'critical'
Index on (project_id, guardian_type) for efficient queries
ForgeStorage methods: createGuardianEvent, listGuardianEvents(projectId, guardianType)

steps.title: Implement guardian spawning
steps.description: Spawn guardian agents with shadow capability

acceptance_criteria.description: spawnGuardian(type, config, projectId) spawns persistent guardian agent
Guardian uses relay shadowOf capability to observe workers
Guardian receives accumulated trajectory from previous runs via storage
Guardian name pattern: guardian-{type}-{projectId}

specification.pattern_description: Use shadowOf capability from relay for non-intrusive observation

steps.title: Implement speak_on trigger system
steps.description: Trigger guardian to speak only on configured events

acceptance_criteria.description: Guardian receives filtered events matching speak_on triggers
Non-matching events observed but not actioned
Guardian can intervene by sending message to worker or alerting human
Intervention recorded in both run trajectory and guardian trajectory

steps.title: Implement guardian retrospective
steps.description: Trigger guardian retrospective at run completion

acceptance_criteria.description: On run completion, prompt active guardians for retrospective
Retrospective summarizes observations, concerns raised, recommendations
Retrospective stored in guardian trajectory for future reference
Optional: send retrospective to human for review

steps.title: Implement predefined guardian types
steps.description: Create prompt templates for standard guardian types

acceptance_criteria.description: Security guardian: monitors for credential exposure, injection risks, auth issues
Architect guardian: monitors for boundary violations, pattern inconsistencies
QA guardian: monitors for test coverage, quality regressions
Each type has specific speak_on defaults and prompt template
GET /guardians lists active guardians for project
GET /guardians/:type/trajectory returns guardian trajectory
POST /guardians/:type/spawn spawns guardian for project
POST /guardians/:type/stop stops guardian
